title: Fix progressive brightness in scene-off orbit flashlight renders
objective: Investigate why the scene_off_flashlight_on orbit render gets progressively brighter and implement a focused fix so scene-off flashlight-only renders remain stable across frames. Preserve the active-illumination trio contract, fixed exposure behavior, and existing output structure.
instructions: Review examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py, examples/flashlight/run_orbit_workflow.sh, examples/flashlight/orbit_light_settings.json, tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py, and the flashlight README/docs sections.

Determine whether progressive brightening is likely caused by temporal renderer history, exposure, Lumen/indirect accumulation, render target persistence, scene light grouping order, or repeated flashlight/light state mutation.
Implement the smallest code/config change that stabilizes scene-off flashlight-only render brightness across orbit frames.
Favor explicit runtime/render config flags that disable temporal accumulation/history for orbit data collection if appropriate.
Add or update lightweight tests around the new behavior/config plumbing.
Do not run a full live simulator render unless it is cheap and safe; if not run, report that clearly.
constraints: Preserve the three default render conditions: scene_on_flashlight_off, scene_off_flashlight_on, scene_on_flashlight_on.
Preserve fixed exposure behavior and existing output directory/video structure.
expected_outputs: ResultPacket explaining root cause and validation
definition_of_done: Root cause is explained in the ResultPacket.
Live render validation gap is explicitly stated if not run.
